복사
SELECT DISTINCT B.customer_id AS CUST_ID, B.membership_level AS member_grade,
  '나이 >= 30, 나이 <= 39, 성별 = F, 고객 상태 = ACTIVE' AS segment_label
FROM cust_profile B
WHERE B.customer_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (
    (B.age >= 30)
      AND (B.age <= 39)
      AND (B.gender = 'F')
      AND (B.customer_status = 'ACTIVE')
  )
